## Location

SharpXstudios is based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and serves businesses in RR Nagar, Rajarajeshwari Nagar, and across Bangalore.

## Web Development

SharpXstudios builds modern, responsive websites and web applications using technologies including React and Next.js.

## AI Automation

SharpXstudios develops AI-powered automation systems, AI agents, and workflow automations to help businesses reduce repetitive tasks and improve operations.
